exposure: Robson classification categories (gestational age, pregnancy categories, prior obstetrical records, progress of labor and delivery)
outcome: Distribution of CS across Robson groups
cohort: The study included 1198 pregnant women who underwent CS delivery at Aga Khan University Hospital between July 1st and December 31st, 2022.
finding: Robson Group 5 emerged as the primary contributor to the overall CS rate (34.3%), followed by Group 10 (28.5%).
mod_finding: Robson Group 5 was the primary contributor to the overall cesarean section rate, making up approximately 34.3% of cases.
